Then no second version is stored

  Scenario: AC6 A 448-row RESTRUCTURE workbook with an extra ignored column is accepted, the minimum is read from its parameter and the author cannot approve (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given "U-7101" posts a 448-row RESTRUCTURE workbook with one extra column that the registry ignores
    When the load is made
    Then the workbook is accepted and the scenario minimum 50 is read from the parameter rules.testcases.min
    Then route sets and version states are read as values of LOV-ROUTE-SET and LOV-VERSION-STATUS and never as code
    Then the caller reference is recorded with no personal data, the grant id is recorded where a break-glass grant is active, and no decision-record row is written
    Then "U-7101" holding RW-COE cannot approve the version, and the approval is the registry's

  Scenario: AC7 A call with no session, a caller without the right or an unknown version is answered 401, 403 or 404 and nothing is stored (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given no session is presented on POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/rule-version-loads
    When the call is made
    Then the response is 401 with message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-AD011-APP-AC7) and the workbook is not parsed
    Given "U-7110" holds RW-CASEOWN with the R letter only in Rules and parameters
    When "U-7110" posts the RESTRUCTURE workbook
    Then the response is 403 with message MSG-P4-002 and no parse is done
    Given a versionId that does not exist
    When GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/rule-version-loads/{versionId} is called
    Then the response is 404 with message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-AD011-APP-AC7)
